subject: Contemplus DR readiness - SOC2 & RTO/RPO walkthrough request
messages:
From: Alan Murphy <alan.murphy@contemplus.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: security@contemplus.com
Date: 2027-01-12T09:12:00Z
Subject: Contemplus DR readiness - SOC2 evidence request

Hi Connor,

We're preparing for our SOC 2 review and our audit team has asked for a compact set of DR/BCP artifacts for Redwood's production environment as the provider of inference for our core product. Can you share the following (or confirm where we can download):

- A short excerpt of the DR runbook that covers automated failover and runbook steps for a regional outage (we mainly need the TL;DR plus critical phone-tree).
- RTO and RPO targets for the serving runtime and the control plane, and the latest measured results from a failover drill.
- Any recent test logs or a recording link from your most recent failover (we don't need raw VM images).
- An attestation or signed note from Redwood that the runbook and tests reflect the current production configuration (DocuSign is fine).

We also have a few clarifying questions on replication topology (async vs. sync for key KV caches) and how long your warm pools take to spin up under sustained load. Ideally we'd like to schedule a 30 minute walkthrough next week to review the runbook live.

Can you confirm what you can provide and a mutually workable time for the walkthrough?

Thanks,
Alan
Security Engineering
Contemplus Inc
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alan Murphy <alan.murphy@contemplus.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-12T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Contemplus DR readiness - SOC2 evidence request

Hi Alan — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to help and can provide a compact package for your SOC 2 audit. High level: we can supply the runbook excerpt, a summary of RTO/RPO targets and the latest measured results, sanitized test logs, and a signed attestation.

Proposal: 30 minute walkthrough on Friday, 2027-01-15 at 15:00 PT (we'll do a live run-through of the DR steps and answer replication questions). If that works for you we will send a calendar invite.

I've CC'd Marissa and Tessa to pull together the artifacts — expect an interim email from us by EOD tomorrow with attachments and the DocuSign packet.

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-12T11:15:00Z
Subject: FW: Contemplus DR readiness - internal prep

Connor / Tessa — quick plan to prepare artifacts:

Action items (Connor):
- Draft the external email with attachments and proposed walkthrough slot (you've volunteered).

Action items (Tessa):
- Pull the recent failover summary (10-Jan test), sanitize any IPs, export the CSV summary, and grab the recording link.
- Extract the DR runbook excerpt that specifically covers regional failover and the communication tree (max 2 pages).
- Prepare an RTO/RPO table (targets vs. measured) with one-line notes on test conditions.

I'll review the packet and sign off on the attestation before DocuSign. Keep the artifacts light — auditors prefer concise artifacts rather than the whole runbook.

Marissa
Director, Customer Security Programs
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-13T08:09:00Z
Subject: RE: Contemplus DR readiness - artifacts prepared

Attaching the following (see attachments):
- DR_runbook_excerpt.pdf — 2-page excerpt covering active-region failover, warm pool spin-up, and rollback criteria.
- failover_test_summary_20270110.csv — anonymized rows: start/end timestamps, steps executed, measured RTOs for control plane and serving nodes, notes on load during test.
- failover_recording_link.txt — secure playback link (internal) to the test recording.

Notes:
- RTO targets: control plane 60 minutes; serving runtime (inference path) 30 minutes under normal warm pool conditions.
- Measured (2027-01-10 drill): control plane full recovery observed in 48 minutes (rolling restart + DB failover), median serving inference path RTO 22 minutes for cold shards, 8 minutes for warm-cached shards.
- RPO: under normal nightly snapshots we have a 1 hour point-in-time recovery target for session metadata; KV caches are async-replicated with best-effort loss window ~5–10 minutes in extreme scenarios.

I've redacted internal hostnames and account IDs from the CSV. The recording contains some internal orchestration logs; I left that as the link rather than attaching the raw file.

Tessa
Senior Reliability Engineer
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alan Murphy <alan.murphy@contemplus.com>
Cc: security@contemplus.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-13T14:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Contemplus DR readiness - SOC2 evidence request

Alan — attaching the concise packet for your review. Attachments included: DR_runbook_excerpt.pdf, failover_test_summary_20270110.csv, failover_recording_link.txt, and a one-page RTO/RPO attestation that Marissa will sign and initiate via DocuSign (RTO_RPO_attestation_signed.pdf once signed).

Key answers inline:
- Replication topology: KV caches are async between AZs with tombstone-based reconciliation. Critical metadata sits in synchronously replicated storage for the control plane.
- Warm pools: typical spin-up to serve traffic in 6–12 minutes depending on model size; end-to-end to warm inference caches measured at ~15–20 minutes for very large models.
- Failover procedure: automated route shift to warm region + service-level restart. The attached excerpt shows the manual override steps auditors ask to see.

Calendar: we proposed Fri 2027-01-15 15:00 PT for the 30 minute walkthrough — sending invite now. If you'd prefer a different time zone please tell us and we'll re-schedule.

Connor
From: security@contemplus.com <security@contemplus.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-14T17:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Contemplus DR readiness - SOC2 evidence request

Thanks Connor — packet received and those numbers look good. A couple of follow-ups before the walkthrough:

- Can you confirm whether KMS/HSM key rotation events are present in the failover logs or if those are omitted for security? We may need proof of key continuity for encrypted snapshots.
- During the walkthrough we'd like to see the concrete sequence: detection -> decision -> route-shift -> validation. Please be prepared to share the specific DB promotion command used (we understand sanitized versions are fine).

We'll join the proposed 15:00 PT slot. Alan (copied) will be the primary security contact on our side.

– Contemplus Security
(on behalf of Alan Murphy)
